function.name: list_users

function.name: create_user
function.description: Create a new user in the organization.

userPrincipalName.description: User principal name in email format (e.g., john.doe@contoso.com)

employeeType.description: Worker type (e.g., Employee, Contractor, Consultant, Vendor)

otherMails.description: Additional email addresses (max 250 entries, 250 chars each)

function.name: get_user
function.description: Retrieve a specific user by their ID or userPrincipalName.

id.description: User identifier (UUID format). Either 'id' or 'userPrincipalName' must be provided.

userPrincipalName.description: User principal name in email format (e.g., 'alice.manager@techcorp.com'). Either 'id' or 'userPrincipalName' must be provided.

function.name: update_user
function.description: Update user properties.

id.description: User identifier - accepts either user ID (UUID) or userPrincipalName (e.g., 'alice_manager' or 'alice.manager@techcorp.com')

givenName.description: Given name (first name) - null to clear

mail.description: Primary email address - null to clear

businessPhones.description: Business phone numbers - null to clear

mobilePhone.description: Mobile phone number - null to clear

preferredLanguage.description: Preferred language code - null to clear

accountEnabled.description: Account enabled state (true/false). Omit to leave unchanged.

userType.description: User classification (Member or Guest) - null to clear

otherMails.description: Additional email addresses - null to clear

ageGroup.description: Age group classification - null to clear

isResourceAccount.description: Resource account flag - null to clear

function.name: delete_user

id.description: User identifier (UUID format). Either 'id' or 'userPrincipalName' must be provided.

userPrincipalName.description: User principal name in email format (e.g., 'alice.manager@techcorp.com'). Either 'id' or 'userPrincipalName' must be provided.

function.name: restore_user

function.name: create_chat
function.description: Create a new chat (one-on-one or group) following Microsoft Graph API v1.0 specification.

chatType.description: Type of chat to create: 'oneOnOne' or 'group'

topic.description: Chat topic/title. Optional for oneOnOne (must be null), required for group chats. Maximum 255 characters.

members.description: List of conversation members. Each member must include @odata.type, roles, and user@odata.bind. Minimum 2 members required.

roles.description: Roles assigned to the member. In-tenant guest users must be assigned 'guest' role. Out-of-tenant external users must be assigned 'owner' role.

user@odata.bind.description: URL to user resource. Format: 'https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/users('user-id')' or 'https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/users('user-principal-name')'

tenantId.description: Tenant ID for federated users (external users from another organization)

installedApps.description: Apps to install in the chat during creation (optional)

teamsApp@odata.bind.description: URL to teams app resource. Format: 'https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/appCatalogs/teamsApps/app-id'

consentedPermissionSet.description: Consented permission set with RSC (Resource-Specific Consent) permissions (optional)

function.name: get_chat
function.description: Get a chat by ID.

user_id.description: User ID or user principal name (email) to act on behalf of (only for application tokens). For delegated tokens, this parameter is ignored. Examples: user ID '8b081ef6-4792-4def-b2c9-c363a1bf41d5' or email 'john@contoso.com'.

function.name: update_chat

function.name: list_chat_messages
function.description: List messages in a chat (Microsoft Graph API compliant).

userId.description: User identifier (user ID or user principal name). REQUIRED for application permissions to specify which user's context to operate in. NOT required for delegated permissions (uses authenticated user automatically). Example: 'alice_manager' or 'alice.manager@techcorp.com'

$top.description: Controls the number of items per response. Maximum allowed $top value is 50.

$orderby.description: Currently supports the lastModifiedDateTime (default) and createdDateTime properties in descending order. The ascending order is currently not supported.

$filter.description: Sets the date range filter for the lastModifiedDateTime and createdDateTime properties. The lastModifiedDateTime property supports the gt and lt operators. The createdDateTime property supports the lt operator. Examples: 'lastModifiedDateTime gt 2021-01-01T00:00:00.000Z and lastModifiedDateTime lt 2021-12-31T23:59:59.999Z', 'createdDateTime lt 2021-12-31T23:59:59.999Z'

function.name: get_chat_message
function.description: Get a specific message from a chat by message ID (Microsoft Graph API compliant).

userId.description: User identifier (user ID or user principal name). REQUIRED for application permissions to specify which user's context to operate in. NOT required for delegated permissions (uses authenticated user automatically). Example: 'alice_manager' or 'alice.manager@techcorp.com'

function.name: get_all_retained_messages
function.description: Get all retained messages from all chats that a user participates in (Microsoft Graph API compliant).

userId.description: User identifier (user ID or user principal name). REQUIRED for application permissions (this endpoint ONLY supports application permissions - delegated NOT supported). Example: 'alice_manager' or 'alice.manager@techcorp.com'

model.description: Payment model for licensing: A, B, or empty for evaluation mode

$filter.description: Microsoft Graph API $filter parameter (exact from documentation table). Supported filters: Date range (lastModifiedDateTime gt/lt with ISO 8601 dates), User identity type (from/user/userIdentityType eq 'aadUser'|'onPremiseAadUser'|'anonymousGuest'|'federatedUser'|'personalMicrosoftAccountUser'|'skypeUser'|'phoneUser'), Application type (from/application/applicationIdentityType eq 'aadApplication'|'bot'|'tenantBot'|'office365Connector'|'outgoingWebhook'), User ID (from/user/id eq '{oid}'), Message type (messageType eq/ne 'systemEventMessage'). Filters can be combined with 'and' operator. Examples: 'lastModifiedDateTime gt 2020-06-04T18:03:11.591Z and lastModifiedDateTime lt 2020-06-05T21:00:09.413Z', 'messageType ne systemEventMessage', 'from/user/userIdentityType eq aadUser'

function.name: get_all_messages
function.description: Get all messages from all chats that a user participates in (Microsoft Graph API compliant).

userId.description: User identifier (user ID or user principal name). REQUIRED for application permissions (this endpoint only supports application permissions). Example: 'alice_manager' or 'alice.manager@techcorp.com'

model.description: Payment model for licensing: A, B, or empty for evaluation mode

$filter.description: OData $filter parameter supporting Microsoft Graph getAllMessages filters: Date range (lastModifiedDateTime gt/lt 2020-06-04T18:03:11.591Z), User identity type (from/user/userIdentityType eq 'aadUser'), User ID (from/user/id eq '{oid}'), Message type (messageType eq/ne 'systemEventMessage'), Application type (from/application/applicationIdentityType eq 'aadApplication'). Filters can be combined with 'and' operator. Examples: 'lastModifiedDateTime gt 2020-06-04T18:03:11.591Z and lastModifiedDateTime lt 2020-06-05T21:00:09.413Z', 'messageType ne systemEventMessage', 'from/user/userIdentityType eq aadUser'

function.name: get_all_messages_delta
function.description: Get incremental changes to messages using delta sync (Microsoft Graph API compliant).

userId.description: User identifier (user ID or user principal name). REQUIRED for application permissions (this endpoint ONLY supports application permissions - delegated NOT supported). Example: 'alice_manager' or 'alice.manager@techcorp.com'

$top.description: Number of items per response (maximum 50 for delta)

$deltatoken.description: State token from previous @odata.deltaLink for incremental sync

$skiptoken.description: State token from previous @odata.nextLink for pagination

$filter.description: VERY LIMITED filter support per Microsoft Graph API. Supported: 'lastModifiedDateTime gt {date}' (ONLY gt, NO lt/eq/ne/ge/le), 'from/user/userIdentityType eq {type}', 'from/application/applicationIdentityType eq {type}', 'from/user/id eq {id}', 'messageType ne systemEventMessage'. IMPORTANT: Date range filters with 'and' are NOT supported. Example: 'lastModifiedDateTime gt 2024-08-27T07:13:28.000Z'

function.name: send_chat_message
function.description: Send a new message in a chat (Microsoft Graph API compliant). API Endpoint: POST /chats/{chat_id}/messages.

body.description: Message body content (required). Plaintext/HTML representation of the content of the chat message. Representation is specified by the contentType inside the body. The content is always in HTML if the chat message contains a chatMessageMention.

replyToId.description: Read-only. ID of the parent chat message or root chat message of the thread. (Only applies to chat messages in channels, not chats.)

subject.description: Subject of the message, in plaintext (optional)

summary.description: Summary text of the chat message that could be used for push notifications and summary views or fall back views. Only applies to channel chat messages, not chat messages in a chat.

importance.description: The importance of the chat message. The possible values are: normal, high, urgent.

locale.description: Locale of the chat message set by the client. Always set to en-us.

attachments.description: References to attached objects like files, tabs, meetings etc.

id.description: Read-only. Unique id of the attachment.

contentType.description: The media type of the content attachment. It can have the following values: reference, file, card.

contentUrl.description: URL for the content of the attachment. Supported protocols: http, https, file and data.

content.description: The content of the attachment. If the attachment is a rich card, set the property to the rich card object. This property and contentUrl are mutually exclusive.

thumbnailUrl.description: URL to a thumbnail image that the channel can use if it supports using an alternative, smaller form of content or contentUrl. For example, if you set contentType to application/word and set contentUrl to the location of the Word document, you might include a thumbnail image that represents the document. The channel could display the thumbnail image instead of the document. When the user clicks the image, the channel would open the document.

teamsAppId.description: The ID of the Teams app that is associated with the attachment. The property is used to attribute a Teams message card to the specified app.

mentions.description: List of entities mentioned in the chat message. Supported entities are: user, bot, team, channel, chat, and tag.

id.description: Index of an entity being mentioned in the specified chatMessage. Matches the {index} value in the corresponding <at id="{index}"> tag in the message body.

mentionText.description: String used to represent the mention. For example, a user's display name, a team name.

mentioned.description: The entity (user, application, team, or channel) that was @mentioned.

user.description: If a user is mentioned, this property contains the user details.

userIdentityType.description: Type of user identity. The possible values are: aadUser, onPremiseAadUser, anonymousGuest, federatedUser, personalMicrosoftAccountUser, skypeUser, phoneUser, unknownFutureValue and emailUser.

application.description: If an application is mentioned, this property contains the application details.

conversation.description: If a conversation (team/channel) is mentioned, this property contains the conversation details.

channelIdentity.description: If the message was sent in a channel, represents identity of the channel. This property is null for chat messages.

teamId.description: The identity of the team in which the channel is located.

channelId.description: The identity of the channel in which the message was posted.

policyViolation.description: Defines the properties of a policy violation set by a data loss prevention (DLP) application.

dlpAction.description: The action taken by the DLP provider on the message. Supported values are: none, notifySender, blockAccess, blockAccessExternal.

justificationText.description: Justification text provided by the sender of the message when overriding a policy violation.

policyTip.description: Information to display to the message sender about why the message was flagged as a violation.

userAction.description: Indicates the action taken by the user on a message blocked by the DLP provider. Supported values are: none, override, reportFalsePositive.

verdictDetails.description: Indicates what actions the sender may take in response to the policy violation. Supported values are: none, allowFalsePositiveOverride, allowOverrideWithoutJustification, allowOverrideWithJustification.

messageType.description: The type of chat message. The possible values are: message, chatEvent, typing, unknownFutureValue, systemEventMessage.

function.name: create_subscription
function.description: Create a subscription for change notifications (Microsoft Graph API compliant). API Endpoint: POST /subscriptions. Permission type: Delegated (Chat.Read, Chat.ReadWrite) + Application (Chat.Read.All, Chat.ReadWrite.All). Per Microsoft Graph API: 'To create a subscription, your app must have read permissions for the resource.' Supports chat-related subscription resources like chats/{id}, chats/{id}/messages, users/{id}/chats/getAllMessages.

changeType.description: Type of change that will raise a notification

notificationUrl.description: The URL of the endpoint that will receive the notifications

resource.description: The resource path to monitor for changes. Examples: 'chats/getAllMessages', 'me/chats/getAllMessages', 'users/{id}/chats/getAllMessages', 'teams/getAllMessages', 'me/mailFolders('Inbox')/messages', 'me/messages', 'me/contacts', 'me/events', 'users', 'groups'

expirationDateTime.description: Specifies the date and time when the webhook subscription expires in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2016-11-20T18:23:45.9356913Z')

clientState.description: Specifies the value of the clientState property sent by the service in each notification. The maximum length is 255 characters

latestSupportedTlsVersion.description: Specifies the latest version of Transport Layer Security (TLS) that the notification endpoint supports

includeResourceData.description: When set to true, change notifications include resource data

encryptionCertificate.description: A base64-encoded representation of a certificate with a public key used to encrypt resource data in change notifications

encryptionCertificateId.description: A custom app-provided identifier to help identify the certificate needed to decrypt resource data

applicationId.description: Identifier of the application used to create the subscription

notificationQueryOptions.description: OData query options for specifying value for the targeting resource

lifecycleNotificationUrl.description: The URL of the endpoint that receives lifecycle notifications

function.name: send_activity_notification_to_user_in_chat
function.description: Send an activity feed notification to user in scope of a chat (Microsoft Graph API compliant).

topic.description: Topic of the notification. Specifies the resource being talked about. Uses teamworkActivityTopic structure.

source.description: Type of source. Possible values are: entityUrl, text. For supported Microsoft Graph URLs, use entityUrl. For custom text, use text.

value.description: The topic value. If the value of the source property is entityUrl, this must be a Microsoft Graph URL. If the value is text, this must be a plain text value.

webUrl.description: The link the user clicks when they select the notification. Optional when source is entityUrl; required when source is text.

activityType.description: Activity type declared in the Teams app manifest. Must match an activity type defined in the app manifest.

content.description: The preview text content. Microsoft Teams shows the first 150 characters.

contentType.description: Content type of the preview text

recipient.description: Recipient of the notification. Must specify @odata.type and recipient-specific properties.

oneOf.description: Send notification to a specific user

@odata.type.description: OData type for AAD user notification recipient

oneOf.description: Send notification to all chat members

@odata.type.description: OData type for chat members notification recipient

chatId.description: Chat ID whose members will receive the notification

oneOf.description: Send notification to all team members

@odata.type.description: OData type for team members notification recipient

teamId.description: Team ID whose members will receive the notification

oneOf.description: Send notification to all channel members

@odata.type.description: OData type for channel members notification recipient

channelId.description: Channel ID whose members will receive the notification

templateParameters.description: Optional values for template variables defined in the activity feed entry corresponding to activityType in the Teams app manifest.

chainId.description: Optional. The chain ID of the notification. Used to override a previous notification. Use the same chainId to override the previous notification.

teamsAppId.description: Optional. The Teams app ID of the Teams app associated with the notification. Used to disambiguate installed apps when multiple apps with the same Microsoft Entra ID app ID are installed for the same recipient user.

iconId.description: Optional. The unique icon ID that allows apps to send customized icons per activity type. Icon IDs must be present in the Teams app manifest schema. If the icon ID is specified in the manifest but missing from the API request body, the icon falls back to the default icon for the app.

                    2. participants_v2.id (supports: eq)
